@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine.ts";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+`{{path}}` HTML-escapes values; `{{{path}}}` leaves them raw. Use `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` for conditionals and `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}` for arrays. Within an `each`, `{{this}}` is the item and `{{@index}}` is its index. `{{! comments }}` emit nothing.
+
+Run a template from files:
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts template.txt data.json
+```
+
+Run self-tests with `bun test`.

19: function parse(template: string): Node[] {
20:   const root: Node[] = [];
21:   const stack: Array<Extract<Node, { type: "if" | "each" }>> = [];
22:   let current = root;
23:   let cursor = 0;
24: 
25:   while (cursor < template.length) {
26:     const start = template.indexOf("{{", cursor);
27:     if (start === -1) {
28:       if (cursor < template.length) current.push({ type: "text", value: template.slice(cursor) });
29:       break;
30:     }
31:     if (start > cursor) current.push({ type: "text", value: template.slice(cursor, start) });
32: 
33:     const triple = template.startsWith("{{{", start);
34:     const close = triple ? "}}}" : "}}";
35:     const end = template.indexOf(close, start + (triple ? 3 : 2));
36:     if (end === -1) fail(template, start, "Unclosed tag");
37:     const raw = template.slice(start + (triple ? 3 : 2), end).trim();
38:     const next = end + close.length;
39: 
40:     if (triple) {
41:       if (!raw) fail(template, start, "Empty interpolation");
42:       current.push({ type: "variable", path: raw, escaped: false });
43:     } else if (raw.startsWith("!")) {
44:       // Comments intentionally do not create output.
45:     } else if (raw.startsWith("#")) {
46:       const match = /^#(if|each)\s+(.+)$/.exec(raw);
47:       if (!match) fail(template, start, "Unknown or malformed block");
48:       const node: Extract<Node, { type: "if" | "each" }> = {
49:         type: match[1] as "if" | "each", path: match[2].trim(), children: [], alternate: [], hasElse: false,
50:       };
51:       current.push(node);
52:       stack.push(node);
53:       current = node.children;
54:     } else if (raw === "else") {
55:       const block = stack.at(-1);
56:       if (!block) fail(template, start, "Else outside a block");
57:       if (block.hasElse) fail(template, start, "Duplicate else");
58:       block.hasElse = true;
59:       current = block.alternate;
60:     } else if (raw.startsWith("/")) {
61:       const name = raw.slice(1).trim();
62:       const block = stack.at(-1);
63:       if (!block || (name !== "if" && name !== "each") || block.type !== name) {
64:         fail(template, start, "Mismatched or unexpected closing block");
65:       }
66:       stack.pop();
67:       current = stack.length ? (stack.at(-1)!.hasElse ? stack.at(-1)!.alternate : stack.at(-1)!.children) : root;
68:     } else {
69:       if (!raw) fail(template, start, "Empty interpolation");
70:       current.push({ type: "variable", path: raw, escaped: true });
71:     }

74:   if (stack.length) fail(template, template.length, `Unclosed ${stack.at(-1)!.type} block`);

78: function lookup(path: string, context: Context): unknown {
79:   if (path === "this") return context.value;
80:   if (path === "@index") return context.index;
81:   const parts = path.split(".");
82:   let value: unknown = context.value;
83:   for (const part of parts) {
84:     if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && part in value) value = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
85:     else {
86:       value = context.root;
87:       for (const rootPart of parts) {
88:         if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && rootPart in value) value = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[rootPart];
89:         else return undefined;
90:       }
91:       return value;
92:     }
93:   }
94:   return value;
95: }

97: function truthy(value: unknown): boolean {
98:   return !(value === false || value === null || value === undefined || value === 0 || value === "" || (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0));
99: }
100: 
101: function scalar(value: unknown): string {
102:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
103:   if (typeof value === "object" || typeof value === "function") throw new Error("Cannot render an object or function as scalar text");
104:   return String(value);
105: }
106: 
107: function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
108:   return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({ "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """, "'": "'" })[char]!);
109: }
110: 
111: function renderNodes(nodes: Node[], context: Context): string {
112:   return nodes.map((node) => {
113:     if (node.type === "text") return node.value;
114:     if (node.type === "variable") {
115:       const value = scalar(lookup(node.path, context));
116:       return node.escaped ? escapeHtml(value) : value;
117:     }
118:     const value = lookup(node.path, context);
119:     if (node.type === "if") return renderNodes(truthy(value) ? node.children : node.alternate, context);
120:     if (!Array.isArray(value)) return renderNodes(node.alternate, context);
121:     if (value.length === 0) return renderNodes(node.alternate, context);
122:     return value.map((item, index) => renderNodes(node.children, { ...context, value: item, index })).join("");
123:   }).join("");
